npcdefault.htm.text: I have nothing to say to you

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/32135-001.h.text: Newbie Guide: How can I help you today? What do you wish to know?

links.text: Ask about teleporting to Newbie Town.
Check the list of available Support Magic.
Get support with a Newbie item.

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/32135-002.h.text: Newbie Guide: My advice is useful for young Kamael just starting out in the world. You seem to be experienced enough not to need my advice. Am I right? Be courageous and confident, and you need depend on no one else.

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/32135-003.h.text: Newbie Guide: It is my task to lead the other Kamael here. However, the current of the times is now leading even other races to this place. Unfortunately, I lack the experience and perspective to provide other races with advice. I am currently contacting each of their embassies, however, so perhaps…

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/32135-04.ht.text: Newbie Guide: Where can we find the person you are seeking?

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/32135-04a.h.text: Newbie Guide: Select the one you seek below. Their location will be indicated on the screen.

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/32135-04b.h.text: Newbie Guide: Choose the name of the person that you are looking for and they will be identified.

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/32135-05.ht.text: Newbie Guide: To meet the person you seek, move in the direction of the arrow.

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/32135-kff05.text: Newbie Guide: First, consider your goal. It should be the central axis around which your life as an adventurer revolves -- a way of life, not simply a destination. We live in an ability-oriented world where the powerful can control entire continents, regardless of their race or class. Ah, and what …

Newbie Guide: Unless someone provides you with something better, you will likely start with the basic weapon and armor commonly distributed to beginners. You can upgrade your weapons and armor by defeating monsters and taking theirs. If you hole some trumps, you can also obtain items like a pair of…

Newbie Guide: First, catch Grey Keltir or the Dominant Grey Keltir in the less dangerous areas of town. After you have acquired some experience, try to catch the Black Wolf or Dominant Black Wolf . Be cautious: the wolves in this area may be too strong for you right now! Here's a tip so for determi…

Newbie Guide: When you reach level 5, you can learn the skill for the first time by going to the Hierarch's House , where the Masters and the Hierarch stay. It is located north of the village square, so you should be able to easily find it. You can learn the skill from the Master. By the way, you n…

links.text: "I'd like to know more about skills."

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/32135-kff05.text: Newbie Guide: There are two kinds of skills: active and passive. Active skills can be used directly on the target. Passive skills , on the other hand, permanently increase your basic abilities. If you are a Kamael soldier, you can use some skills to raise your abilities. If you are at level 5, you'…

Newbie Guide: Good question! Have you talked to the inhabitants of the town? Many of them need help. When you click Quest , they will ask a favor of you. No matter how dire their need may be, however, they will never ask for something you cannot do. If someone hesitates to ask a favor of you, it te…

Newbie Guide: I will give you whatever information I know for certain. However, I don't know everyone who needs help. You'd better go to town and talk to the inhabitants yourself. First, visit the Hierarch's House and meet Vice Hierarch Zenya . She has something of importance to say to novice adven…
Newbie Guide: So, what do you want to know? Do not hesitate to ask any question.

links.text: "What do I have to do now?"
"Tell the most suitable hunting site for me."
"Is there any available quest for me?"

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/32135-kff10.text: Newbie Guide: From now on, you must pay more attention! Listen to me carefully: the most important thing for you to have is the will to seek adventure in the deepest parts of the Isle of Souls. Follow that will and you may feel yourself already becoming a stronger Kamael. Ah, one last thing! When y…

Newbie Guide: Which weapon do you use now? What kind of weapon do you want to use in the future? The reason why I'm asking this question is that it is important that you find the most suitable weapon for you when you reach level 6. If you think that a Dagger is the best fit, buy a Bone Dagger . If …

links.text: "I'd like to know the characteristics of each weapon."

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/32135-kff10.text: Newbie Guide: Weapons are divided into 7 types: One-Handed Sword, Two-Handed Sword, Blunt Weapon, Dagger, Polearm, Fist and Bow. Among those, let's first focus on the two Sword types, Blunt Weapons, Dagger and Bow. If you are a Kamael, listen especially carefully about the One-Handed Sword, Two-Han…

links.text: Two Handed Sword and Blunt Weapon.

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/32135-kff10.text: Newbie Guide: The One-Handed Sword is the most basic weapon in the game, possessing balanced attributes. The Squire's Sword you began your adventures with was one of these. Unless you prefer a specific weapon, I recommend staying with a One-Handed Sword. You can also use Fallen Attack with it, whic…

Newbie Guide: A One-Handed Blunt Weapon has a higher accuracy than other weapons, but a low Critical Rate. Blunt Weapons are designed to reliably cause a lot of damage . I recommend them for hunters, for example. As you advance, you can acquire skills specifically for Blunt Weapons. Something to ke…

Newbie Guide: A Two-Handed Sword or Two-Handed Blunt Weapon possesses both formidable power and reach compared to their one-handed counterparts. That power comes at the price of quickness, however. These weapons are a good choice for those who rely on inflicting devastating damage in combat. But if…

Newbie Guide: A Dagger allows you to attack with unsurpassed speed, as well as the greatest chance of inflicting critical damage. However, its accuracy is low, its reach is quite short and even its critical damage is low compared to other weapons on the same level. A Dagger also has a very small ra…

Newbie Guide: Obviously, the advantage of a Bow is its ability to deliver damage at range. It is the slowest weapon, but can also inflict the greatest damage, making it ideal for support in combat. If you master the bow, however, it is possible to use it as your primary weapon. In addition, a bow c…

Newbie Guide: If you have hunted well, you can equip yourself with good armor. Otherwise, you will have to upgrade gradually. Once you've reached level 6, you can wear Apprentice's Shoes, Cloth Caps and Short Gloves with your armor. If you are particularly lucky, you may acquire a full set of leath…

Newbie Guide: If you are looking for suitable monsters to fight at this level, seek out Green Goblins or Mountain Werewolves . When you are more comfortable hunting monsters, you may also test yourself against a Muertos Archer or Mountain Fungus . To hunt any of these monsters, take the road leadin…

Newbie Guide: At this level, if you have a preferred attack skill, train hard to develop it. Upgrade the ones you already use most when you reach Level 10. You usually learn support skills after acquiring attack skills, so now is the time to learn skills such as Armor Mastery , Weapon Mastery , Mag…

Newbie Guide: Once you reach Level 10, you should visit Hierarch Kekropus . He will supervise a ceremony necessary for you to become a true Kamael warrior. Also seek out Zerstorer Marcela at the entrance of the village. She is troubled by the increasing number of monsters in the Hills of Gold and w…

Newbie Guide: Ah! You have matured a great deal since you last visited me. I am glad to see the change in you. I do not know if I can be of much help to you now, but feel free to ask. If you already know the answer I give, come back to me after you reach level 11. At that time I will be able to giv…

links.text: "What do I have to do now?"
"Tell the most suitable hunting site for me."
"Is there any available quest for me?"

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/32135-kff15.text: Newbie Guide: Do you want to know why this is a transition period? Now is the time you should begin considering which higher-level occupation to choose. Of course, you can choose when you reach level 18 or 19, but in the meantime you should practice a few things. First of all, you'd better fight ag…

links.text: "I want to know about fighting in groups."

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/32135-kff15.text: Newbie Guide: Usually, when several people hunt together, they form a party . You can join a party by using Invite at Action Tab( ALT + C ) in "Character Info." First, click on the person you wish to invite into your party, then click the Invite icon. Perhaps you should simply join a party to under…

links.text: "I'd like to travel in a party."

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/32135-kff15.text: Newbie Guide: Very well. Travelling alone is not always easy, but it has its own rewards. But if you really want to live and hunt alone, you should know a few things first. Timing is important for hunting. To progress at the best rate, you must reduce the time between battles to a minimum. Defeatin…

Newbie Guide: It requires serious preparation to be an effective part of a group. Experience is the best teacher, but I can tell you some of the basics. For now, your occupation or gender matters little; the most important thing is to find people you can trust and work well with . When you look at …

Newbie Guide: You can go into combat with the weapons you have acquired through quests. But once you reach level 15, you may find that you need more attack power. At that point, you can trade weapons with other people. You can trade items, too. It is more beneficial to trade with people than go to …

Newbie Guide: Have you considered the next weapon you wish to purchase? Broadswords are mere children's toys to you now. At level 12 or 13, the Gladius is an excellent choice for a Sword, the Dirk for a Dagger and the Dwarven Mace for a Blunt Weapon. Of course, it's too expensive to buy at the shop…

Newbie Guide: At your current level, a Wooden Breastplate and Hard Leather Pants Set would make an effective combination. You should seek Leather Shoes, a Wooden Helmet and Gloves to complete your set. You cannot be fully equipped with those items because you are only at level 11, but if you buy th…

Newbie Guide: It's time for you to learn about other items. I'm sure that by now you've used a lesser healing Potion, but there's a lot more that you need to know about it if you plan to succeed. First, let's talk about Accessories . Basically, Accessories raise your magical defense power. Colossus…

Newbie Guide: The hunting area I recommend for warriors at your level is the Hills of Gold , located south of the village. If you choose to hunt Muertos Guards, Muertos Scouts, Muertos Warriors or Colossuses in the Hills of Gold , however, you would be advised to first advance a level. Once you are…

Newbie Guide: True, there are no new skills to learn at this level. But strengthening the skills you already possess is also important. Have you used attack skills like Fallen Attack or Fallen Arrow ? As you know, when you use Fallen Attack while equipped with a dagger or blunt weapon, you can stri…

Newbie Guide: Did you pass the ceremony overseen by Hierarch Kekropus ? It is both meaningful and helpful -- go undertake it. You should also meet Trader Trevor , who can give you some work which will benefit your advancement, allowing you to earn some money while training yourself.

Newbie Guide: You may not feel that you have grown, but I can see it plainly. I am very proud of you! Now, let's talk about something a little different: how to live with other people . This is a transition period for you. Until you reach level 10, masters lead you, just as your parents did when yo…

links.text: "What do I have to do now?"
"What is the most suitable hunting site for me?"
"Is there any available quest for me?"

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/32135-kff20.text: Newbie Guide: As I've told you before, the decision to transfer your profession is a very important one. If you wish, I can tell you more about the professions available to you.

links.text: "I want to know more about professions available."
"I want to know how to choose a profession."

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/32135-kff20.text: Newbie Guide: As you may know, Kamael gender has a dramatic impact on both magical power and physical attributes. As a result, male Kamael may become Troopers , while females are only eligible to become Warders . Don't be too disappointed with that, though -- the Kamael may have fewer options regar…

Newbie Guide: You must journey to the Kingdom of Aden to assume your new profession. You can obtain training in Gludin Village or the Town of Gludio . There is nothing more for you to learn here, in the land of your birth. You can reach the Town of Gludio faster by asking the Gatekeeper to teleport…
Newbie Guide: There's little left to teach you about items. But listen carefully while I explain what I can -- you must know this in order to transfer your occupation.

links.text: Listen to the explanation about armor types.
Listen to the explanation about Soulshot.
Listen to the explanation about item grades.

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/32135-kff20.text: Newbie Guide: Now you should learn about Kamael weapons. A Kamael who completes the first class transfer can learn how to customize other races' weapons to Kamael ones. With that skill, a Kamael can change a One-Handed Sword to a Short Sword, a Two-Handed Sword into a Steel Sword and a Bow into a C…

links.text: Listen to the explanation about item grades. Back.

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/32135-kff20.text: Newbie Guide: Upper and lower body armor are classified as either Robes , Light Gear or Heavy Gear . Kamael use Light Gear. When you transfer your profession at level 20, the armor you wear will influence your choice of skills. For example, Light Armor Mastery is a skill which increases defense pow…

Newbie Guide: Have you ever seen an item called a Soulshot while hunting? You know the Dwarves, right? A Soulshot is a type of bullet devised by the most skilled Dwarven Artisans. It allows you to inflict greater damage, but unfortunately it disappears once used. You will be able to acquire Soulsho…

Newbie Guide: Dwarven craftsmen are said to be able to crystallize anything into Leaguam, Ravi, Ciel or Arch through a process known as the "Crystallization Ritual." These Craftsmen have assigned grades to every material in the world based on the types of crystal they form during this ritual. I am …

Newbie Guide: You can hunt almost everywhere on the Island at your level. Your main targets should probably be a Grotto Golem or a Shady Muertos. You can find monsters in Nornil's Cave, in the northeastern part of the town. If you crave a more difficult challenge, go to the southwest of the cave wh…

Newbie Guide: Without a class change, there is nothing more that you can be taught beyond a certain point. Once you reach level 20, you can change your class. If I advise you in advance, you can also learn the special skills only available to our race. If you prefer to use a thin blade, you can acq…

Newbie Guide: If you want to travel the world, go to Hierarch Kekropus . He knows a hidden truth about our race, which I have heard that he will only reveal to a fully-grown Kamael like you. Also seek Vice Hierarch Perwan in the Cave of Souls. He needs someone to eradicate the Crimson Spiders who h…

Newbie Guide: Ah, I see that you have become a brave Kamael warrior! Now it is vital that you to finish your basic training and prepare for your class transfer. Among Kamael soldiers, a woman warrior may only become a Warder, but that is still strong enough.

links.text: "What do I have to do now?"
"What is the most suitable hunting site for me?"
"Is there any available quest for me?"

@questlist.text: Quest list window (the server lists the quests this NPC has for you; shown only when there is more than one).

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/pk-protecti.text: Newbie Guide: The Blessing of Protection is available to characters under level 39 who have not completed their second class transfer. Protected by its power, you cannot receive damage from (or inflict damage to) chaotic characters who are 10+ levels above you. It will not protect you on the battle…

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/newbie-toke.text: Newbie Guide: Newbie Guides offer teleportation between Newbie Towns to any character below level 20. If you use this service, it is also possible to visit the starting village of another race through a Newbie Guide . But be careful how you use this advantage -- it is normal to learn a specific ski…

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/buffs-playe.text: You are eligible to receive the following supplemental magic: Levels 6-75: Wind Walk Levels 6-75: Shield Levels 6-75: Magic Barrier Levels 6-75: Bless the Body (Fighter), Bless the Soul (Wizard) Levels 6-75: Vampiric Rage (Fighter), Acumen (Wizard) Levels 6-75: Regeneration (Fighter), Concentration…

ai/npc/Teleports/NewbieGuide/newbie-guid.text: Newbie Guide: To congratulate you on your achievements, the Adventure Guild is pleased to open its warehouse to both apprentice adventurers who have reached level 6 as well as to travelers who have completed their first class transfer. At level 6, you can use the Apprentice Adventurer's Weapon Exch…
